notes_for_editor: Story rests mainly on Lighthouse Friends (secondary, itself drawing on Colonist 1903, Graham 1986, family info); keeper roster is from it alone. Source 7 name/station matched by column position. Derby year differs: Sechelt archives says 1865, real Thormanby win was 1860 and LF says 1860; story flags the difference. Staffing 'as of 2024' from LF roster only; 2015 heritage designation not verified (Parks DFHD page would not load). Ownership (Fisheries and Oceans) from record, not cited. Fact-check: source 7 appointment date (8 Jan 1904) read from page image, not in OCR text, so no evidence quote. Sechelt gives Franklin until 1933 vs LF 1932; Sechelt caption implies Copeland followed Franklin directly, LF lists Fleming and LeClerc between.
